mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings valuation.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 10.0% signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers equity risk aversion and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust aggregate demand and supply chain resilience, reducing equity risk and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recovery economic regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal renewed consumer confidence and construction activity that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances during the post-recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained payroll growth (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that trigger monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous federal funds rate decline and unemployment rate increase signals monetary policy response to labor market shock, increasing equity volatility and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor shock
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances during supply-constrained regimes.
